extraction.Name: Josephine Collins
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 4, 1920, by the Gregory County Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to W. H. Tackett for $3200, mortgage released February 23, 1921; conveyed by deed to W. H. Tackett for $4400 on January 25, 1921
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739682 issued; Lots 3 and 4, and East half of Southwest quarter section 31, township 100, north of range 73. Receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 3, 1920. On April 3, 1920, Mrs. Collins and husband conveyed the Southwest quarter section 31 to W. H. Tackett; on May 24, 1920, Josephine Collins and husband mortgaged the land to W. H. Tackett for $3200; on May 24, 1920, Tackett deeded Lots 3 and 4 and East half of Southwest quarter section 31 back. Husband named Charles Collins.
